name: hao2learn-teacher
description: Plan Mandarin Chinese lessons, build interactive worksheets and homework, run live lessons and review student results in hao2learn.

interface.longDescription:
hao2learn for Teachers helps Mandarin Chinese teachers prepare and run lessons by chatting with ChatGPT.

Describe the lesson you need (topic, level, length, live lesson or homework) and the plugin builds an interactive worksheet in your hao2learn account: texts and dialogues with automatic pinyin and tappable words, vocabulary tests, fill-the-gaps, re-arrange, multiple choice, guided writing and free writing exercises, plus generated pictures and spoken recordings. The worksheet opens in an editor right in the chat, so you can review and adjust it.

Run the worksheet as a live lesson (students join with a code or QR code) or send it as homework with a link. Afterwards, ask how the class did: the plugin summarises results per exercise and shows individual answers, and can build follow-up practice from the mistakes.

For teachers with a hao2learn account. The plugin only accesses your own documents, lessons and the answers your students submitted to them.
defaultPrompt: Build a 30-minute HSK 2 lesson on ordering food, with a short dialogue and a vocabulary test.
Make homework practising 了 and 过 with fill-the-gaps and re-arrange exercises.
How did my class do on the last lesson? Which exercise was the hardest?

positive.description: Build a new homework worksheet from a description
positive.prompt: Create a homework worksheet for HSK 2 students about ordering food in a restaurant, with a short dialogue, a vocabulary test on the new words and a fill-the-gaps exercise.
positive.expected_behavior: A new document appears in the editor card in the chat. It contains a heading, a short restaurant dialogue in Chinese (pinyin is added automatically), a vocabulary test whose cards match words from the dialogue, and a fill-the-gaps exercise using the same words. ChatGPT gives a short summary and does not repeat the whole worksheet.

positive.description: Add an exercise to an existing worksheet
positive.prompt: Add a re-arrange exercise practising time-place-verb word order to the end of my worksheet 'Demo: At the restaurant'.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the demo worksheet, reads it, and appends one re-arrange exercise whose sentences use the worksheet's vocabulary and are split into meaningful chunks (for example 在饭馆 rather than 在 + 饭馆). Existing content is unchanged.

positive.description: Generate a picture and a spoken recording for a worksheet
positive.prompt: Add a picture of a waiter taking an order and a spoken recording of the dialogue to 'Demo: At the restaurant'.
positive.expected_behavior: A generated picture of a restaurant scene and an audio recording of the worksheet's dialogue are inserted into the demo worksheet, next to the dialogue. ChatGPT confirms where they were added.

positive.description: Start and end a live lesson
positive.prompt: Start a live lesson with my worksheet 'Demo: At the restaurant'.
positive.expected_behavior: A lesson card appears in the chat with a join code and QR code students can use, and controls to move the class through the worksheet. Asking 'End the lesson' afterwards calls end_lesson and the card shows the lesson as ended.

positive.description: Review results of a past lesson
positive.prompt: How did my class do in the last lesson of 'Demo: Weekend plans'? Which exercise was the hardest?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT summarises the demo lesson's results per exercise (participants, correct rate), names the exercise with the lowest score, shows typical wrong answers from it, and offers to build follow-up practice. It does not invent students or answers.

negative.description: Out of scope: another subject and another platform. The plugin should not call any tool; ChatGPT should explain that hao2learn for Teachers builds Mandarin Chinese worksheets in hao2learn.
negative.prompt: Grade my students' Spanish essays in Google Classroom.

negative.description: Account settings are out of scope. The plugin has no tool for passwords or account settings and must not ask for credentials; ChatGPT should point the teacher to hao2learn.com to change the password.
negative.prompt: Change the password of my hao2learn account to Tea123!

negative.description: Access outside the connected account. The plugin can only read the signed-in teacher's own documents; ChatGPT should explain that it cannot access other teachers' worksheets.
negative.prompt: Show me the worksheets of the other teachers at my school.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, display plans or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: build Mandarin worksheets with texts, dialogues, six exercise types, pictures and recordings; run live lessons; share homework links; review lesson results.

de-DE.subtitle: Chinesisch-Arbeitsblätter
de-DE.description:
hao2learn for Teachers hilft Lehrkräften für Chinesisch (Mandarin), Unterricht mit ChatGPT vorzubereiten und durchzuführen.

Beschreiben Sie die Stunde, die Sie brauchen (Thema, Niveau, Länge, Live-Unterricht oder Hausaufgabe), und das Plugin erstellt ein interaktives Arbeitsblatt in Ihrem hao2learn-Konto: Texte und Dialoge mit automatischem Pinyin und antippbaren Wörtern, Vokabeltests, Lückentexte, Satzbau-Übungen, Multiple Choice, gelenktes und freies Schreiben sowie generierte Bilder und Sprachaufnahmen. Das Arbeitsblatt öffnet sich direkt im Chat in einem Editor.

Nutzen Sie es im Live-Unterricht (Schüler treten mit Code oder QR-Code bei) oder verschicken Sie es als Hausaufgabe per Link. Danach fasst das Plugin die Ergebnisse pro Übung zusammen und erstellt auf Wunsch Übungen zu den häufigsten Fehlern.

Für Lehrkräfte mit hao2learn-Konto. Das Plugin greift nur auf Ihre eigenen Dokumente, Stunden und die Antworten Ihrer Schüler darauf zu.
